f.title: Inform NMRAs at the same time as or before public safety announcements
f.statement: When an MAH intends to make a public announcement on safety concerns, it shall inform the relevant NMRAs at the same time or before (Annex 14), and ensure public information is objective and not misleading.
f.clause: Ch. 13 Safety communication for the MAH in the EAC

rows.quote: When marketing authorization holder in the EAC intends to make, a public announcement relating to information on safety concerns in relation to the use of a medical product, and in any event at the same time or before the public announcement is made, the marketing authorization holder shall be required to inform the relevant NMRAs in the Partner States as per (Annex 14)The marketing authorization holder shall ensure that information to the public is presented objectively and is not misleading.

f.title: Inform NMRAs of third-party safety communications
f.statement: When the MAH learns that a third party intends to issue communications that could affect a product’s risk-benefit balance, it should inform the relevant NMRAs and share the content.
f.clause: Ch. 13 Safety communication for the MAH in the EAC

rows.quote: Whenever a marketing authorization holder becomes aware that a third party intends to issue communications that could potentially impact the risk-benefit balance of a medicinal product registered in the EAC, the marketing authorization holder should inform the relevant NMRAs in Partner States and make every effort to share the content of the communications with the relevant NMRAs.

f.title: Report immediately when withdrawing a product for safety reasons
f.statement: An MAH withdrawing a product due to safety concerns shall immediately report to the NMRAs.

f.title: Appeal NMRA suspension/cancellation within 30 calendar days with grounds
f.statement: An MAH may appeal in writing an NMRA suspension or cancellation within 30 calendar days of the NMRA notification, giving grounds for each reason based only on information already in the dossier.
f.exceptions: New information not previously submitted is not accepted
